steps.tx: An autoimmune connective tissue disease characterized by widespread vascular endothelial injury, fibroblastic activation, and excessive collagen accumulation defines **systemic sclerosis** (scleroderma). Progressive microvascular obliteration stimulates unregulated transforming growth factor-beta and platelet-derived growth factor signaling. Hyperactivated dermal and visceral fibroblasts overproduce extracellular matrix proteins, leading to progressive cutaneous sclerosis and visceral organ fibrosis affecting the gastrointestinal tract, lungs, and kidneys. Clinically divided into limited and diffuse cutaneous subtypes based on the anatomical extent of skin thickening.
steps.say: An autoimmune connective tissue disease characterized by widespread vascular injury, fibroblastic activation, and excessive collagen accumulation defines systemic sclerosis. Progressive microvascular obliteration stimulates unregulated growth factor signaling. Hyperactivated fibroblasts overproduce extracellular matrix proteins, leading to progressive skin thickening and visceral fibrosis affecting the digestive tract, lungs, and kidneys. Patients are classified into limited and diffuse subtypes.

left.title: Limited Cutaneous Scleroderma
points: Skin thickening distal to elbows and knees only
Prominent CREST syndrome features
Anti-centromere antibodies (ACA) in 70-80%
Late pulmonary arterial hypertension (PAH)
Long indolent course with Raynaud preceding by years

right.title: Diffuse Cutaneous Scleroderma
points: Skin thickening proximal to elbows/knees & trunk
Anti-topoisomerase I (anti-Scl-70) antibodies
Early severe interstitial lung disease (NSIP)
High risk of acute Scleroderma Renal Crisis
Rapid onset within months of Raynaud

steps.tx: Reversible episodic digital microvascular vasospasm triggered by cold exposure or emotional stress represents the earliest clinical manifestation of systemic sclerosis. In **raynaud phenomenon**, excessive sympathetic alpha-2 adrenergic vasoconstriction combined with structural intimal hyperplasia causes sequential digital colour changes: initial pallor (white) from arteriolar vasospasm, followed by cyanosis (blue) from capillary deoxygenation, and reactive erythema (red) from reperfusion hyperemia. In secondary Raynaud associated with scleroderma, nailfold video-capillaroscopy characteristically reveals enlarged megacapillaries, micro-haemorrhages, and progressive capillary drop-out indicating structural microangiopathy.
steps.say: Reversible episodic digital microvascular vasospasm triggered by cold exposure or emotional stress represents the earliest clinical manifestation of systemic sclerosis. In Raynaud phenomenon, excessive sympathetic vasoconstriction combined with intimal hyperplasia causes sequential colour changes: pallor from vasospasm, cyanosis from deoxygenation, and erythema from reperfusion. Nailfold video-capillaroscopy reveals enlarged megacapillaries and capillary drop-out, signaling underlying connective tissue disease.

vis.alt: Clinical progression of digital triphasic colour changes in Raynaud phenomenon.
vis.caption: Sequential microvascular triphasic colour changes (pallor, cyanosis, erythema) in Raynaud phenomenon. [Credit: StewardMD]

steps.tx: A clinical constellation of five characteristic manifestations defines the classic presentation of limited cutaneous systemic sclerosis. The **crest syndrome** encompasses Calcinosis cutis (insoluble calcium hydroxyapatite deposits in subcutaneous tissues), Raynaud phenomenon, Esophageal dysmotility (smooth muscle atrophy producing severe gastro-oesophageal reflux and dysphagia), Sclerodactyly (tight, bound-down skin over fingers with claw flexion deformities), and Telangiectasias (dilated cutaneous capillary loops on the face, lips, and hands). Patients with CREST syndrome harbour a lifelong risk of isolated precapillary pulmonary arterial hypertension.
steps.say: A clinical constellation of five characteristic manifestations defines the classic presentation of limited cutaneous systemic sclerosis. The CREST syndrome encompasses Calcinosis cutis, Raynaud phenomenon, Esophageal dysmotility, Sclerodactyly, and Telangiectasias. Esophageal involvement causes severe reflux and dysphagia, while sclerodactyly causes claw hand contractures. Patients with CREST syndrome harbour an elevated lifelong risk of isolated precapillary pulmonary arterial hypertension.

rows: Taut, shiny, tethered skin with clawing
Mat-like erythema on face, lips, palms
Pulsed dye laser therapy for cosmetic concerns

steps.tx: Specific serological autoantibodies correlate precisely with distinct clinical subsets, patterns of visceral involvement, and long-term prognosis. Circulating **anti-centromere** antibodies (ACA), directed against kinetochore proteins CENP-A and CENP-B, occur in up to eighty percent of patients with limited cutaneous scleroderma and CREST syndrome, predicting severe Raynaud and isolated pulmonary arterial hypertension while protecting against renal crisis. Conversely, antibodies targeting topoisomerase I (anti-scl-70) occur predominantly in diffuse cutaneous disease, strongly predicting rapidly progressive pulmonary interstitial fibrosis and increased mortality.
steps.say: Specific serological autoantibodies correlate precisely with distinct clinical subsets, patterns of visceral involvement, and long-term prognosis. Circulating anti-centromere antibodies occur in eighty percent of patients with limited cutaneous scleroderma, predicting severe Raynaud and isolated pulmonary arterial hypertension. Conversely, antibodies targeting topoisomerase I, termed anti-Scl-70, occur in diffuse disease, strongly predicting rapidly progressive pulmonary interstitial fibrosis.

left.title: Anti-Centromere Antibodies (ACA)
points: Targets CENP-A / CENP-B kinetochore proteins
Found in 70-80% of limited scleroderma / CREST
High association with severe Raynaud & Telangiectasias
Predicts late Pulmonary Arterial Hypertension (PAH)
Low incidence of renal crisis or pulmonary fibrosis

right.title: Anti-Scl-70 (Anti-Topoisomerase I)
points: Targets DNA topoisomerase I nuclear enzyme
Found in 30-40% of diffuse systemic sclerosis
Strongly predicts progressive Interstitial Lung Disease (NSIP)
Associated with extensive proximal skin sclerosis
Carries higher overall mortality

steps.tx: A life-threatening medical emergency striking up to ten percent of patients with diffuse cutaneous systemic sclerosis causes malignant hypertension and acute oliguric renal failure. In **scleroderma renal crisis**, rapid intimal proliferation and concentric onion-skin hyperplasia of renal interlobular arteries causes severe cortical hypoperfusion, triggering explosive renin secretion by the juxtaglomerular apparatus. Patients present with abrupt onset of accelerated hypertension, microangiopathic haemolytic anaemia with schistocytes, and rapid creatinine elevation. Administering oral ACE inhibitors (captopril titrated rapidly to full dose) is life-saving, reversing renal vasoconstriction and preserving kidney function.
steps.say: A life-threatening medical emergency striking up to ten percent of patients with diffuse cutaneous systemic sclerosis causes malignant hypertension and acute oliguric renal failure. In scleroderma renal crisis, rapid intimal proliferation of renal interlobular arteries triggers explosive renin secretion. Patients present with accelerated hypertension, microangiopathic haemolytic anaemia with schistocytes, and acute renal failure. Administering oral ACE inhibitors such as captopril is life-saving, reversing renal vasoconstriction.

nodes.label: Diffuse Scleroderma: Renal Interlobular Artery Intimal Hyperplasia
Severe Cortical Ischaemia Triggers Explosive Renin Cascade
Malignant Hypertension (> 180/110) + Acute Oliguric AKI + MAHA
Immediate Oral Captopril Titration: Reverses Vasoconstriction

steps.tx: A chronic autoimmune epithelitis targeting exocrine glands produces progressive keratoconjunctivitis sicca and xerostomia. Clinically recognized as **sjogren syndrome**, autoreactive CD4 T-helper cells and polyclonal B lymphocytes infiltrate salivary and lacrimal glands, driving acinar epithelial cell apoptosis. Patients present with gritty dry eyes, severe dry mouth causing accelerated dental caries, parotid gland enlargement, and profound fatigue. Extra-glandular manifestations include cutaneous purpura from hypergammaglobulinaemic purpura, interstitial nephritis, and a forty-fold increased lifelong risk of developing B-cell non-Hodgkin lymphoma (predominantly marginal zone MALT lymphoma).
steps.say: A chronic autoimmune epithelitis targeting exocrine glands produces progressive keratoconjunctivitis sicca and xerostomia. Clinically recognized as Sjogren syndrome, autoreactive lymphocytes infiltrate salivary and lacrimal glands, driving acinar cell destruction. Patients present with gritty dry eyes, severe xerostomia causing rampant dental caries, and parotid gland enlargement. Extra-glandular disease includes interstitial nephritis, purpura, and a forty-fold elevated risk of B-cell MALT lymphoma.

steps.tx: Objective clinical assessment of deficient tear secretion evaluates lacrimal gland hypofunction at the bedside. Performing the **schirmer test** involves placing a standardised five-millimetre sterile filter paper strip into the lower conjunctival sac of each eye without topical anaesthesia. After five minutes, the length of wetting by tears is measured. Wetting of five millimetres or less confirms severe aqueous tear deficiency (keratoconjunctivitis sicca). Ocular surface staining with fluorescein or lissamine green visualizes punctate corneal epithelial erosions, confirming ocular surface damage resulting from chronic tear film absence.
steps.say: Objective clinical assessment of deficient tear secretion evaluates lacrimal gland hypofunction at the bedside. Performing the Schirmer test involves placing a sterile filter paper strip into the lower conjunctival sac of each eye without anaesthesia. After five minutes, the length of wetting is measured. Wetting of five millimetres or less confirms severe tear deficiency. Ocular staining with lissamine green visualizes corneal epithelial erosions resulting from chronic dryness.

nodes.label: Place Sterile Whatman Filter Paper Strip in Lower Conjunctival Fornix
Patient Keeps Eyes Gently Closed for Exactly 5 Minutes
Measure Wetting Length: Normal > 10 mm / Abnormal <= 5 mm
Confirms Severe Aqueous Tear Deficiency (Keratoconjunctivitis Sicca)

steps.tx: Diagnostic classification of Sjögren syndrome combines objective sicca testing with serological autoantibody detection and minor salivary gland histopathology. Testing reveals positive **anti-ro and anti-la** autoantibodies in up to eighty to ninety percent of patients. Labial minor salivary gland biopsy from the inner lower lip provides definitive histopathological confirmation, demonstrating focal lymphocytic sialadenitis defined by a focus score of one or more (aggregates of >= 50 mononuclear cells per 4 mm2 of glandular tissue). Symptomatic management employs artificial tears, oral pilocarpine or cevimeline muscarinic agonists, and meticulous dental hygiene.
steps.say: Diagnostic classification of Sjögren syndrome combines objective sicca testing with serological autoantibody detection and salivary gland histopathology. Testing reveals positive anti-Ro and anti-La autoantibodies in most patients. Labial salivary gland biopsy provides definitive confirmation, demonstrating focal lymphocytic sialadenitis with a focus score of one or higher. Symptomatic management employs artificial tears, oral pilocarpine muscarinic agonists, and meticulous oral hygiene.
